create_interactions: create a new interaction using Google's Interactions API with a model or agent and input text
create_streaming_interactions: create a streaming interaction with a gemini model and return an async iterator of response chunks
get_interactions: get an interaction by its ID using the Google Interactions API endpoint
delete_interactions: delete an interaction by its ID and return a deletion result
cancel_interactions: cancel a running interaction by its ID and return a cancellation result
